questions.question: Write 4 sentences in Spanish about articles, adjectives and agreement.

points.text: Four sentences using topic vocabulary, with correct adjective agreement, articles and verb conjugation. Include at least two different tenses for Higher tier.

questions.question: Write a paragraph (40-60 words) giving your opinion on articles, adjectives and agreement.

points.text: A structured paragraph with: introduction (en mi opinión...), opinion with reason (creo que... porque...), a different viewpoint (sin embargo...), and a conclusion (en conclusión...). Use connecting words and varied vocabulary.

questions.question: Translate into Spanish: "I think articles, adjectives and agreement is important because..."

points.text: "Creo que [topic] es importante porque..." — ensure adjective agreement (masculine/feminine), correct verb form, and give a specific reason.

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Writing task: Write about definite and indefinite articles, adjective agreement, position of adjectives, demonstratives, possessives. <div class="

points.text: A grade 9 answer will: use at least three tenses accurately; include complex structures (subordinate clauses, pronouns, negation); show precise grammar (agreement, conjugation, accents); express and justify opinions; include cultural knowledge; use a wide range of vocabulary; be well-organised with connecting words (sin embargo, además, por lo tanto, en conclusión). Mark scheme: Content (relevance and detail) + Quality of language (accuracy and range) = total marks
